context:
Goal: replaced PRs close without waiting on you.
Problem (rule): auto mode refuses a PR close with no word of yours in that chat, so each replaced PR waits for you.
Based on (measured): the close of q_max #969 was refused at 23:30 CST.
Based on (ruling): a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
Departs from: today auto mode refuses those closes — (a) adds an allow line for a PR close plus one comment by the merging and coordinating sessions.
holds: Closing replaced PRs in every repo.

options.gain: Replaced PRs close without your word each time.
options.how: A lane adds an allow line so the merging and coordinating sessions may close a PR and post one comment.
options.label: Allow the close
options.lose: Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo. A wrong close by those sessions goes through with no check; it can be reopened.

options.gain: No PR closes without your word.
options.how: You close each replaced PR yourself, or say yes to each close on this page.
options.label: Keep the refusal
options.lose: Each replaced PR waits for you.

ref: q_max PR #969 close refused at 23:30 CST
reply: Withdrawn 23:44 CST: the coordinator's session can close a replaced PR without a new allow line (it closed q_max #969 at 23:43), so nothing needs widening.
title: Let the merging sessions close a replaced PR without asking you each time?
why: Auto mode refused the merging session's close of q_max #969, a PR replaced by #1010, at 23:30 CST. Today you close each replaced PR, or say yes to each close.
